joinLines.line: 🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
🚶 A stranger walks into Haven. They're thin, scared, and carrying nothing. "Please," they say. "I heard you have food." (Drama: do you share?)

📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Marco Ocampo is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
🕯️ Marco Ocampo is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Marco kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Marco's gone." Larry looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Marco." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
📖 The Codex turns a page: Marco Ocampo, 33 days. The mantle passes to Aroha Ngata.
The village's quarrel was with Marco — and Marco is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Larry, Tikhon, Pilar and 2 more speak for Aroha — "Marco trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
That night, they bring Marco home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
